statuses.name: AI edit planning and shot recognition
statuses.message: Edits are planned by the built-in rules planner, which works without any account. To add AI planning, set AI_PROVIDER=anthropic and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server. Until then, tag Before, Result and Reaction clips by hand to unlock those styles.

statuses.name: Speech captions
statuses.message: Captions are switched off because no transcription service is set up. Set TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=deepgram and DEEPGRAM_API_KEY on the server to caption spoken words. Edits never show invented dialogue.

statuses.name: Local disk storage
statuses.message: Videos are stored on this server’s disk. Fine for one machine; switch to cloud storage (STORAGE_DRIVER=s3) before hosting in the cloud.

statuses.name: Instagram
statuses.message: Needs setup: a Meta developer app is required. Add META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET to the server, then connect your Instagram professional account in Settings → Integrations.

statuses.name: TikTok
statuses.message: Needs setup: a TikTok developer app is required. Add TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY and TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET to the server, then connect TikTok in Settings → Integrations. Until then, download the export and upload it in the TikTok app.

statuses.name: Square Appointments
statuses.message: Needs setup: add SQUARE_APPLICATION_ID and SQUARE_APPLICATION_SECRET from your Square developer dashboard to the server, then connect Square in Settings → Integrations. No bookings are shown until then.

statuses.name: Email sending (Resend)
statuses.message: Needs setup: create a Resend account, verify your sending domain, then add RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM to the server. Nothing is emailed until then.

statuses.name: Google Business Profile
statuses.message: Needs setup: add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from a Google Cloud project to the server, then connect your Business Profile in Settings → Integrations. Review requests can still use your review link from Settings → Business.

statuses.name: Google Search Console
statuses.message: Needs setup: add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to the server, then connect Search Console in Settings → Integrations. You also need your website verified in Search Console.
